title: 第23章 神光冲宵通神境凶兽现第24章 战通神境凶兽必败无疑
slug: 玄幻长生神子何须妹骨证道
content_zh:
虚空秘境外。
顾青以及六位族老，此时惊讶的瞪大眼睛。
不过，顾青瞬间回过神来，调整自已的表情，但是上扬的嘴角简直比AK都难压！
其他族老则是惊叹。
“长歌神子突破命轮，竟然如同脱胎换骨！”
“顾元序列好歹身具天王体，身具一百零八块王骨，天生王者，那一拳在灵力招式加持之下起码千万斤巨力，然而长歌神子一拳，就击败了顾元序列，日后成就难以想象。”
“我长生顾家将会再出一尊大帝！”
一众族老说完，全部羡慕的看向顾青。
顾青还是忍不住笑出声，哈哈笑道：“诸位族老说笑了，长歌想要独当一面还早呢。”
……
“神子无敌！
！”
“神子太强了，竟然连曾经和您争锋的顾元序列，都能一拳击败！”
顾长歌走在队伍前方，身后一群顾家族女俏脸红晕，美眸极为崇拜的望着那道出尘身姿。
顾清秋跟在顾长歌身侧，并没有开口，但美眸亦是忍不住往他身上瞧。
没办法！
现在的顾长歌太过耀眼，纵使她这位重生至尊，同龄之下恐怕也是稍有不如。
凭借至尊骨，外加上脑海中能收获的机缘信息，才有可能在突破命轮境时，达到现在顾长歌命轮境二层的层次！
“突破境界，实力大增而已。”
顾长歌侧脸对身后一众族女道。

看着那张完美的侧脸，一众族女内心尖叫，实在是太帅了！
虽说稍显稚嫩，可却已经极为出尘俊朗，微光相伴如仙光，身着金贵黑衣，散发着像是罂粟般的致命诱惑力，又带着高高在上的贵气。
就连顾景这些顾家男性子弟，亦是内心只有尊崇，生不起丝毫嫉妒。
“轰”
突然，一道恐怖神光，瞬间冲霄而起。
神光荡漾，阵阵涟漪。
突如其来的冲霄神光，吸引了整个虚空秘境的人注意。
与此同时。
令牌上也出现了两道求救信息。
是顾紫玉，顾潇潇掌控的队伍发出的求救信息。
令牌除了记录积分，查看队伍排名，个人排名之外，也有求救功能，附近序列队伍碰到的话可以过去搭救，搭救成功可以获得那支队伍一半积分。
顾长歌眺望神光荡漾之地，又看了眼令牌，心里已经有了猜想。
现在顾紫玉和顾潇潇同时发出了求救信息，很有可能两支队伍是一起行动的，而且看样子是一起遇到了她们无法解决的问题。
两支队伍凑在一起，而且还是两个序列联手！
命轮境四五层，更甚至七八层凶兽鬼怪应该不至于求救。
那么只有一个可能！
那就是他们遇到命轮境九层，乃至通神境凶兽鬼怪。
“神子，这个方向好像是我知道的那个通神境机缘方向。”
知晓通神境机缘的顾烨，拿出一枚玉佩感应了一下，立即对顾长歌道。
“是吗？”

顾长歌眸光闪了闪，下一刻说出了一个让一众人震惊的话：“接下来你们不用出手了，全部交给我，你们跟上我的速度就行。”
content_en:
Outside the secret realm of void.
Gu Qing and the six clan elders widened their eyes in surprise.
However, Gu Qing came to his senses instantly and adjusted his expression, but the raised corners of his mouth were even harder to suppress than AK!
Other clan elders were amazed.
"The Son of God Changge breaks through the Wheel of Life, and it's as if he has been reborn!"
"After all, Gu Yuan sequence has the body of a heavenly king and one hundred and eight king bones. He is a born king. With the blessing of spiritual moves, that punch is at least tens of millions of kilograms strong. However, the Son of God of Changge defeated Gu Yuan sequence with one punch. His future achievements are unimaginable."
"My Changsheng Gu family will give birth to another great emperor!"
After the clan elders finished speaking, they all looked at Gu Qing with envy.
Gu Qing still couldn't help but laugh out loud, and said with a laugh: "You guys are just kidding, it's too early for Changge to take charge of his own business."
…
“The Son of God is invincible!
! "
"The Son of God is so strong, he can even defeat the Gu Yuan sequence who once competed with you with one punch!"
Gu Changge walked at the front of the team. Behind him, a group of girls from the Gu family had blushing faces, and their beautiful eyes looked at the immortal figure with great admiration.
Gu Qingqiu followed Gu Changge without saying a word, but her beautiful eyes couldn't help but look at him.
no way!
Gu Changge is too dazzling now. Even though she is a reborn supreme, she is probably a little inferior to her peers.
With the help of the Supreme Bone and the opportunity information that can be harvested in the mind, it is possible to reach the current second level of Gu Changge's Life Wheel Realm when he breaks through the Life Wheel Realm!
"Breaking through the realm only increases your strength greatly."
Gu Changge turned sideways and said to the female clansmen behind him.
Looking at that perfect profile face, all the clan girls screamed inwardly, he is so handsome!
Although he looks a little immature, he is already extremely handsome, with a faint light like fairy light. He is dressed in gold and black clothes, exuding a fatal temptation like a poppy, and with a noble aura.
Even Gu Jing, the male children of the Gu family, only have respect in their hearts and cannot bear the slightest jealousy.
"Boom"
Suddenly, a terrifying divine light shot into the sky instantly.
Divine light ripples, waves ripple.
The sudden divine light rising into the sky attracted the attention of everyone in the Void Secret Realm.
at the same time.
Two distress messages also appeared on the token.
It was a distress message from the team controlled by Gu Ziyu and Gu Xiaoxiao.
In addition to recording points and checking team rankings and personal rankings, tokens also have a rescue function. If a nearby team encounters them, they can go to rescue them. If the rescue is successful, half of the points of that team can be obtained.
Gu Changge looked at the place where the divine light was rippling, then looked at the token, and he already had a guess in his mind.
Now that Gu Ziyu and Gu Xiaoxiao have sent out distress messages at the same time, it is very likely that the two teams are acting together, and it seems that they have encountered problems together that they cannot solve.
The two teams came together, and two sequences joined forces!
The beasts and ghosts on the fourth and fifth levels of the Life Wheel Realm, and even on the seventh and eighth levels, should not be able to ask for help.
Then there is only one possibility!
That is when they encountered the ninth level of the Life Wheel Realm, or even the ferocious beasts and ghosts of the Spiritual Realm.
"Son of God, this direction seems to be the direction of the chance to reach the divine realm that I know."
Gu Ye, who knew the opportunity to reach the divine realm, took out a jade pendant and sensed it, and immediately said to Gu Changge.
"Really?"
Gu Changge's eyes flashed, and the next moment he said something that shocked everyone: "You don't have to take action from now on, just leave it all to me. Just keep up with my speed."
